method.floor: the nav areas reached from the start (links one way, ladders both), each place of the 32 grid inside one, at its height from the four corners
method.solid: world brushes solid or window; func_brush (unless never solid), func_wall, func_breakable, func_breakable_surf; displacements. Doors open; clips, grates, water not solid. Static props are not solid in width, sight and headroom (they are models; their collision is not read); withPropCollision repeats width, sight and headroom with the static props as the engine collides with them (solid 6: the convex hulls of the model's .phy, first solid; solid 2: the model's box; solid 0 and solid 6 without a .phy: not solid), placed by origin and angles; withPropBoxes repeats width and sight with every solid static prop as its model's box (an upper bound)
method.flow: not stored in the .nav: the walked distance from the start areas along the nav links (Dijkstra, area middles through the edges' middles), as the game itself works it out at load
method.stats: per map: median, q1, q3, p5, p95 of its places; per game: n, median, q1, q3, p5, p95 of the maps' values (one map, one vote)
